standards.description: Use parentheses, brackets, or braces in numerical expressions, and evaluate expressions with these symbols.
standards.cluster: Write and interpret numerical expressions.

standards.description: Write simple expressions that record calculations with numbers, and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them.
standards.cluster: Write and interpret numerical expressions.

standards.description: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules. Identify apparent relationships between corresponding terms. Form ordered pairs consisting of corresponding terms from the two patterns, and graph the ordered pairs on a coordinate plane.
standards.cluster: Analyze patterns and relationships.

standards.description: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.
standards.cluster: Understand the place value system.

standards.description: Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying a number by powers of 10, and explain patterns in the placement of the decimal point when a decimal is multiplied or divided by a power of 10.
standards.cluster: Understand the place value system.

standards.description: Read, write, and compare decimals to thousandths.
standards.cluster: Understand the place value system.

standards.description: Use place value understanding to round decimals to any place.
standards.cluster: Understand the place value system.

standards.description: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
standards.cluster: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths.

standards.description: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using strategies based on place value, the properties of operations, and/or the relationship between multiplication and division.
standards.cluster: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths.

standards.description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction.
standards.cluster: Perform operations with multi-digit whole numbers and with decimals to hundredths.

standards.description: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators (including mixed numbers) by replacing given fractions with equivalent fractions in such a way as to produce an equivalent sum or difference of fractions with like denominators.
standards.cluster: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions.

standards.description: Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions referring to the same whole, including cases of unlike denominators.
standards.cluster: Use equivalent fractions as a strategy to add and subtract fractions.

standards.description: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b). Solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to answers in the form of fractions or mixed numbers.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division.

standards.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication to multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division.

standards.description: Interpret multiplication as scaling (resizing).
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division.

standards.description: Solve real world problems involving multiplication of fractions and mixed numbers, e.g., by using visual fraction models or equations to represent the problem.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division.

standards.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of division to divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.
standards.cluster: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division.

standards.description: Convert among different-sized standard measurement units within a given measurement system (e.g., convert 5 cm to 0.05 m), and use these conversions in solving multi-step, real world problems.
standards.cluster: Convert like measurement units within a given measurement system.

standards.description: Make a line plot to display a data set of measurements in fractions of a unit (1/2, 1/4, 1/8). Use operations on fractions for this grade to solve problems involving information presented in line plots.
standards.cluster: Represent and interpret data.

standards.description: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures and understand concepts of volume measurement.
standards.cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume.

standards.description: Measure volumes by counting unit cubes, using cubic cm, cubic in, cubic ft, and improvised units.
standards.cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume.

standards.description: Relate volume to the operations of multiplication and addition and solve real world and mathematical problems involving volume.
standards.cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume.

standards.description: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines, called axes, to define a coordinate system, with the intersection of the lines (the origin) arranged to coincide with the 0 on each line and a given point in the plane located by using an ordered pair of numbers, called its coordinates.
standards.cluster: Graph points on the coordinate plane to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

standards.description: Represent real world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane, and interpret coordinate values of points in the context of the situation.
standards.cluster: Graph points on the coordinate plane to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

standards.description: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.
standards.cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties.

standards.description: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.
standards.cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties.
